name: Trail to the Rule
method: Generated pigment selected by local color and luminance difference; composited over original stone. Deep dark cracks protected. All other pixels retained exactly.
visual_review: Final full PNG and decoded 512-pixel JPEG visually inspected; no known unmet visual requirements.
preserved: All inherited Pepe figures and paintings lie outside the addition and remain pixel-identical; original rock texture, cracks, water, lighting, dimensions and framing retained.
hands: No visible hands or handprints in the inherited wall or new mark; no digits to count.
prohibited_content: No letters, numerals, captions, signatures, logos, watermarks, borders, real people or prohibited symbols observed. New pigment is a flat worn ochre dot, broken charcoal trail and chalk ring.
